name: The Thaw
description: The melting of glaciers after the World Spell, flooding Terisiare.

description_citations.text: "School of the Unseen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Thaw and the Flooding of Terisiare lift the veil hiding the school, and its scholars help evacuate and resettle flood victims.
timeline.quote: During these critical early years they helped evacuate, rescue, and resettle those whose homes and towns were lost to the floods.

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Thaw meets Terisiare and mountains shed their ice, crushing homes.
timeline.quote: As the Thaw met Terisiare, mountains shed their icy skins, crushing homes and hopes alike.

citation.text: Icefall (Coldsnap, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Terisiare enters the Thaw as its icy shell melts and most inhabitants rejoice at the land's rebirth.
timeline.quote: The icy shell that encased the continent is melting away.

citation.text: "Coldsnap", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ysidra shows Vannemir a vision of Heidar and the Thaw.
timeline.quote: He seeks to keep the world encased in ice until the end of time

citation.text: "Vannemir's Choice", section "The choice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: the continent is undergoing the Thaw
